title: UP Anganwadi Worker Bharti Online Form 2026
organization: Uttar Pradesh Anganwadi Recruitment Portal / ICDS
vacancyDetails: District-wise Worker notices are listed on the UP Anganwadi Recruitment Portal; no combined statewide vacancy is published on the portal.
qualification: 12th Pass (Intermediate) from recognized board; local residence criteria as per district notice
ageLimit: As per UP Anganwadi Worker district recruitment rules
applicationFee: Check the concerned district notice and application portal; fee conditions can vary by notice.
selectionProcess: Merit based on educational marks / local criteria → Document Verification → Appointment
documentsRequired: 12th marksheet, residence proof, photo ID, passport photos, category certificate if applicable
howToApply:
1. Visit official UP WCD / district Anganwadi recruitment portal
2. Select district and post – Anganwadi Worker
3. Register and fill online form
4. Upload documents and submit
5. Track merit list on district portal
statusNote: District-wise active notices; dates and eligibility vary by notice
shortDescription: UP Anganwadi Worker Bharti 2026 is being published district-wise. Check the current portal listing for active notices and deadlines.
content:
The UP Anganwadi Recruitment Portal publishes district-wise Anganwadi Worker (AWW) notices.

Current listings include Balrampur, Hamirpur, Fatehpur, Azamgarh, Banda, Chitrakoot and Jhansi among other districts. Vacancy count, centre, residence condition and last date must be checked in the individual district notice.
